items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: I never saw her work in my life. I never saw her work.

ctx.x: See, she came along with Glover and Nettie. Oh, yeah. You know, and she was in the show, show along with them, see. Oh. But, uh... Her name wasn't Martin at that time. Yeah. It was another name. Charlotte was just about to know, but I forgot.
